items.note: The overview names the product as "our B2B note-taking app."
The header lists the audience as engineering and design leads and the status as "Draft for kickoff." The overview frames the document around reaching scope agreement at kickoff.
Requirements R1–R3 and the In v1 scope list cover creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes.
The roles table and R4 limit v1 to two roles, admin and member, and say "two only."
The Out of v1 list gives billing changes, SSO and guest access, matching the request exactly.
The primary metric is stated word for word: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days. Baseline and window start are flagged as gaps or assumptions, not invented.
At roughly 750–850 words, with several compact tables, it fits within about two pages. The gap sections add some padding but don't push it clearly past the limit.
Migration of existing shared notes is the only open question, with the decision it blocks and owners listed. The document says "No answer is proposed or assumed."
